description: Generates a short video with audio from a text prompt.

provenance.note: Captured from a successful Rey_Explosion_H3 run. The LoadImage and ImageScale nodes were removed and node 8's optional first_frame input dropped; the rest of the chain, including the audio branch, is unchanged.

length.note: Frames at 24 fps. 56 is about 2.3s and is the value verified on this machine; 124 is about 5s.

steps.note: The turbo LoRA is tuned for 8 steps.

filename_prefix.note: Set by the orchestrator per job. Never taken from user input.

unsupported.negative_prompt: MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo exposes no negative conditioning input.
unsupported.cfg: This graph uses BasicGuider (no CFG scale input).
unsupported.model_choice: Only one diffusion model is installed.
